meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在 NanoClaw 群里建一个长期 wiki 知识库:创建 wiki/、sources/ 目录和索引、日志文件,写入维护规则,并逐份整理你提供的资料。
howto.when: 当你说出 “add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base” 等关键词时触发;它会先问你想把 wiki 放在哪个群。

say.note: 开始逐步搭建 wiki 知识库

say.text: 给一个专门的群建 wiki
say.note: 会先让你选择群组和频道

say.text: 把这个链接的资料收进 wiki
say.note: 逐份读取来源并更新 wiki 页面

howto.what_en: After install, Claude sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: creating wiki/ and sources/ folders plus index and log files, writing maintenance rules, and integrating your sources one file at a time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base" and similar; it first asks which group should host the wiki.

say_en.note: Starts setting up the wiki step by step

say_en.text: Set up a wiki in a dedicated group
say_en.note: It will ask which group and chat to use

say_en.text: Ingest this link into the wiki
say_en.note: Reads sources one file at a time
